content: Life is never made unbearable by circumstances, but only by lack of meaning and purpose.
author: Viktor Frankl
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. Living in pretense takes an enormous amount of mental energy. When you constantly manage impressions to please others, you end up feeling like an imposter in your own skin.

Viktor Frankl understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Honesty with yourself can feel uncomfortable at first, but it is the only ground upon which a real life can be built. When you stop lying to yourself about your feelings, your energy is immediately freed up.
reflectionPrompt: How can acknowledging your vulnerability help you build deeper self-trust and inner peace?
